requests.prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game equipment sprite concept for Phobos' Halewright Ward-3: a spacecraft infirmary bed from the year 2075, designed in this fictional setting to repair moderate to somewhat severe wounds using nanomachines. Art direction informed by Ostranauts' vanilla ship-equipment sprites: coarse deliberate pixel clusters, practical industrial modules, muted material colours, sparse mechanical detail, very restrained flat shading. This should look like working equipment aboard a cash-strapped spacer's ship, visibly more capable than an ordinary hospital mattress. Draw an original design, not a copy of any game asset.

Tall 3:5 portrait canvas, straight rectangular 3-tile-wide by 5-tile-deep footprint. Head at the TOP edge. Occupy the complete rectangular footprint with the machine, without surrounding floor or padding. A reinforced off-white enamel chassis, mid-grey structural rails and pale mint-grey segmented patient cushion. Small flat headrest at the top of the cushion. Keep the entire central patient area empty and unobstructed, with no person or canopy: a game character must be able to lie over it.

Make the nanomedical function legible through a few useful, physically plausible service components: an integrated head-end treatment housing with a pair of capped replaceable nanomachine suspension cartridges and compact sterile pump modules; recessed feed channels contained inside the side rails; two short articulated treatment/injection manipulators folded into recesses alongside the upper mattress, seen from directly above and parked clear of the patient; small side-mounted wound-treatment pads; a compact maintenance drawer at the foot. These components are integral to the bed, not separate furniture. No pipes or cables extending outside the rectangular footprint. Slight asymmetry in service fittings, a few visible fasteners and latches, broad wear patches rather than dense scratches. One quiet muted blue-teal accent on the treatment housing and cartridge caps. Nanomachines themselves are microscopic and MUST NOT appear as visible little robots, particles or glowing swarms.

PIXEL ART, not a photograph or smooth illustration. Design the image to read as a coarse 48 x 80 logical pixel sprite enlarged cleanly, with crisp square pixel clusters, stepped outlines, a restricted palette of about 24 colours, no anti-aliasing and no gradients. Deliver a high-resolution 3:5 source canvas, ideally 1536 x 2560 or larger, while keeping that coarse logical pixel density. Flat diffuse illumination, minimal local shading only.

No text, numbers, logos, medical crosses, painted screens, gauges, status lights, readouts, people, wounds, blood, floating holograms, magical glow, floor, backdrop scenery, drop shadows, isometric projection, perspective, visible side faces or polished luxury styling. No blanket hiding the working parts.
requests.decision: Retained concept for owner review; not selected for runtime
requests.review: Overhead original mechanical bed with treatment cartridges and manipulators, empty central patient cushion, no text or instruments. Returned art has white margins and a narrower silhouette than the complete 3 x 5 footprint; these need deliberate registration before runtime binding. Nanomachine healing is fictional design intent, not an implemented feature or a clinical finding.

preview.sampling: Nearest-neighbour, whole original canvas; no silhouette registration

licensing.note: Provider provenance and terms references are separate from repository code licensing; no new legal determination made.

registration.method: Edge flood fill removes the white margin (tolerance 28); silhouette 747 x 1590 box-reduced to 88 x 156 px (about a fifth wider, 44 native px like the game's medical bed); 96-colour median cut, no dithering; alpha at half; centred on a transparent 96 x 160 canvas. No provider call.
registration.trialsInspected: Widths 73 (natural), 82, 86, 90 and 94 px and palettes of 32, 48, 64 and 96 colours were compared at 48 x 80 native and enlarged; 88 px and 96 colours kept the round cartridges and the teal accents.
